evidence_scope: Grounded question answering over a registry extract: 26 cases in 10 languages, with unknown, advice-trap, injection and false-premise cases. Direct evidence for explaining approved data; indirect evidence for legal extraction and verification; no evidence for document retrieval or PDF reading.
activation: Used only when DAJC_RESEARCH_MODEL_PROFILE equals profile_id. Explicit DAJC_RESEARCH_* model, price, route and interval settings always win. Keys are never part of the profile.
price_source: vratadajcm-png/dajc-ai-lab run-profile.json, list prices verified 2026-10-25; USD per 1M tokens; reference estimates, not invoices.

ai_lab.name: DAJC AI Lab – Multi-Model Research & Testing

evidence_levels.LIVE_EXTRACTION_VERIFIED: Used in this role in a live AI Lab run whose draft passed every check and reached human review.
evidence_levels.BENCHMARK_INDIRECT: Benchmark of a related task (grounded answering over registry data); provisional for this task.
evidence_levels.API_SMOKE_ONLY: The API answered a live smoke test; nothing about quality.
evidence_levels.NOT_BENCHMARKED: No completed answers or no evidence relevant to this task.
evidence_levels.UNAVAILABLE: The account or tier refused requests in the AI Lab, or the model is excluded until a smoke test passes; not a quality result.

policy.approved_by: owner (DAJC AI Lab integration brief of 2026-10-30)
policy.change_control: Only a reviewed pull request approved by the owner changes this policy. AI Lab results produce proposals (proposePolicyUpdate); a score never activates a model by itself.

tested_languages.evidence: AI Lab live extractions from official documents: cs (cz-sun, Czech act, registry rule matched; runs 40974550043, 40995210487), de (Tyrol B 179 order, REVIEW_REQUIRED draft; run 40996822080).
tested_languages.rule: A document in any other language, or of unknown language, goes to the complex route (DAJC_RESEARCH_TESTED_LANGUAGES).

discover.fallback: official registry sources, authority domains and leads (deterministic retrieval)

verify.rule: another vendor than the extraction that is used

articles.service: the existing Claude pipeline of the Weekly, outside this orchestrator

candidates.note: Needed pacing: 9/26 answers unpaced, 26/26 with a 15 s interval.

candidates.price_status: user reference rate, not current billing
candidates.note: Google routes this ID to Gemini 3.6 Flash; 5 of 26 cases stayed at HTTP 503 high demand.

candidates.excluded_until_smoke_test: Bake-off key had no credit (HTTP 400). The dajc-eu key served claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5 with output_config.format in the Weekly on 2026-10-29, but no case of this test set was answered.
Bake-off key had no credit (HTTP 400); not benchmarked.
HTTP 429 rate_limited from the first request, also with 15-120 s waits: tier limit; check Mistral console limits.
HTTP 429 rate_limited from the first request: tier limit.
HTTP 403 tier_not_allowed: model not in the subscription tier.

search.evidence: Perplexity Search served the dajc-eu Weekly discovery on 2026-10-29 (Final data refresh step); not part of the bake-off. Price is a reference, check the contract.

data_terms: Research sends only public legal documents (data class public-legal); customer vehicles, routes and organisations never go to a research provider.
Gemini: check the Gemini API Additional Terms for the tier in use; content sent on unpaid tiers may be used by Google to improve products.
Mistral is the EU-seated option; currently blocked by the account tier.
